text.content:
Private, underfunded, and still armed like an army.

Kind: Police, privatized
Leadership: A CEO from outside the force
Purpose: Officially, public safety; in practice, revenue and the megacorps' interests

The NCPD went private after the city decided it cost too much. The new CEO cut half the force and patrols, and pushed for income: tickets, a five-eddie-a-minute charge for 911 calls, and "donations" for solving particular crimes.

Underfunded or not, it has armored vehicles, AVs and plenty of firepower, and assume any cop is crooked until they prove otherwise.

Gig hooks

  • An honest detective is paying edgerunners out of pocket to work a case the department won't fund.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.28
